articles.title: BTS Withdraws From Grammy Consideration In Apparent Protest Over New Asian Pop Category - Deadline
articles.description: BTS will not submit its music for Grammy consideration this year, apparently in protest over a new Best Asian Pop Music Performance category.
articles.content: Korean pop group BTS will not submit its music for Grammy consideration this year, apparently in protest over the Recording Academy’s recent decision to launch a new Best Asian Pop Music Performance … [+1638 chars]
